title: Vanilla Adjacent
description: A mod pack with performance enhancing mods along with some visual and audio changes.
body:
This pack is purely client side and intended to be used on realms with friends or for general vanilla minecraft.

There are no mods that add new content as in weapons or armor.

The mods you would expect in a "performance" modpack are here like sodium and iris.

Use this pack if you want simple vanilla minecraft with better performance and minor visual changes.
